parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the toggle part of a wall switch, made of durable plastic and designed for frequent manual operation.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that opens or closes the electrical circuit when toggled up or down.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or rocks around a central axis to switch between ON and OFF positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base plate of the wall switch, typically made of insulating plastic and mounted on the wall.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support for the switch mechanism and houses the electrical connections behind it.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or electrical box.
